caption:
The sun's about to slip behind the cliff, just a sliver of it left above the water.
Up on the ridge the houses are still catching the last light, small and white against the rock.
Behind us the wake keeps unrolling, foam turning gold for a second before it fades back to blue.
Message us on WhatsApp and we'll check what dates are open.
